product.name: Overwolf Development Platform
product.description: A platform enabling developers to create, share, and monetize in-game apps and overlays for PC games using HTML and JavaScript.

product.name: CurseForge Modding Service
product.description: A service offering API, SDK, and plugins for game studios to integrate, manage, and curate mods safely within their games.

product.name: Tebex Monetization Platform
product.description: An all-in-one platform for game studios to create in-game and online stores and grow game revenue through monetization solutions.

product.name: Nitro Advertising Platform
product.description: An advertising technology platform that integrates ads into gaming websites and apps, optimizing revenue while maintaining user experience and site performance.

product.name: Overwolf Advertising Network
product.description: A network that enables brands and advertisers to reach gamers through in-play and beyond-play ads across top gaming apps and websites.

product.description: Desktop applications built on Overwolf that provide game-specific tools such as live stats, communication, economy management, and performance tracking.
